name: CommuteAssistLongCityCommute

custom.system_prompt: You are generating a longer city commute with two navigation moments separated by a 30-minute gap. The driver asks about the route at the start, then checks in again halfway through. Each exchange should be very brief.

sound_effects_config.prompt: City driving, car interior sounds, highway entering, urban to suburban transition

initial_prompt: Generate a commute with two brief navigation moments separated by a 30-minute gap. At the start, the driver asks Sigma for the best route across town. Sigma answers. 30 minutes later, the driver checks — are they on track, how much further? Short exchanges only.

variations.context: Cross-town commute — route check at start, progress check 30 minutes in

setting.mood: Calm but purposeful, a long drive ahead
setting.relationship_dynamic: Solo driver on a familiar but long route
setting.background: Longer commute today, unusual destination. Not sure of the best route. Checks in partway.
setting.conversation_style: Two minimal exchanges with a big gap. Silence in between is the commute.

scenario_template.topic: Driver asks Sigma for the best route — destination, or which roads to take
scenario_template.note: Under 70 chars. E.g. 'Sigma, best way to Hackney from here?' or 'Sigma, which route avoids the motorway?'

scenario_template.topic: Sigma gives route info and estimated time. Driver acknowledges.
scenario_template.note: Sigma: route name or direction + total ETA. One sentence. Driver: 'alright' or nod.

scenario_template.topic: [30 MINUTES PASS — driver has been driving, roughly halfway]
scenario_template.note: No dialogue. 30 minutes of quiet driving have passed.

scenario_template.topic: Driver checks in — how far left, on track?
scenario_template.note: One short question. Sigma gives updated ETA or distance. Driver responds in a word.

user1.name: Kenji
user1.role: Driver on a longer commute. Checks Sigma at start and midway. Very brief in-car speech — most of the time is just driving.

assistant.name: Sigma
assistant.role: Navigation assistant. Gives route and ETA info in one sentence each time. Responds only when addressed.

conversation_structure: Every dialogue line must be under 70 characters.
The 30-minute gap should be felt — the driver is settled in by the second exchange.
Sigma gives a route name or road at start, updated ETA at midpoint.
Driver has short, practical lines only.
No commentary on the scenery or thoughts — just navigation.
assistant_behavior: Sigma responds only when addressed by name.
Sigma gives route or ETA in one short sentence.
No unsolicited traffic updates or suggestions.
